skills.name: Change Working Directory

skills.output: Session directory updated; prompt cache preserved.
compatibility: New skill; no conflict with existing entries.

skills.name: Code Review

skills.output: Risk-ranked findings by correctness, reuse, efficiency.

skills.name: Set Completion Condition
